title: Order record field renamed while the order summary grows

agents.task: In src/lib/db.ts, rename the OrderRecord property `customerEmail` to `email` everywhere in that file (interface and seed data). Do not touch other files.

In src/lib/orders.ts, make orderSummary richer: it must return `<customerEmail> - <total in dollars with two decimals> - <status>` (e.g. `ana@example.com - 12.99 - pending`), using the order's customerEmail, totalCents and status fields. Keep the 'Missing order' branch. Do not touch src/lib/db.ts.
